author: Sega Jenesis
title: Looking for digital artists for custom Pokémon binder scenes
content: 🎨 I’m on the hunt for digital artists! 👀 I’m planning to order some custom Pokémon card binders as holiday gifts, and I’d love to commission an artist to create a scene or two for them! I’m thinking full illustrated Pokémon scenes, not just individual characters. Is it a little late in the year to be looking for holiday commissions? Maybe. 😂 But here I am anyway! Obviously, this is a PAID commission! I absolutely believe in compensating artists for their time and talent. 💚 If you’re an artist or know someone who might be interested, please send them my way! I’d love to see portfolios, pricing, and availability. 🥰

author: Meg Humble
title: Looking for character artists for 2 full body characters under £300
content: I know imma regret this, but I’m looking for character artists who have space in November for 2 full body characters (no background needed) ideally for less than £300 🚫 AI 🚫 DMs Authors please also rec people you have used! 🥰

author: Or Cole
title: Looking for character art for upcoming romance book with flexible payment
content: I'm looking for an artists that can do character art for my up coming book. And who's willing to work with me because money is tight. So a lot up front wouldn't work but I can definitely pay you what you're worth. Just not up front. No AI please. I am so fucking serious no AI please!

author: romancefictionclub
title: Hiring character artist for large project (human-made only)
content: We’re looking to hire a character artist who can take on a large project. Any authors have reccomendations? Human made artwork only please.

author: Montrose Starling
title: Looking for artist for character art and cover art for next series
content: Hey Authors and Artists! I'm looking for someone who can help me with character art and cover art for my next series. Any recommendations? If you're an artist, self reds are welcome. Please include a link to your website or portfolio!
